data.name: Infect: The Last Stand
data.detailed_description:
Step into a relentless Hardcore PvPvE world, powered by the cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5. In this unforgiving landscape, every decision carries a consequence, and every step could be your last. Survival isn't just a goal—it’s a constant struggle against both the environment and those who hunt within it.

Key Features

  • Dynamic Day/Night Cycle: Time is your greatest ally and your worst enemy. Scavenge under the safety of sunlight, but prepare for the darkness when visibility drops and the infected become more aggressive and lethal.

  • Diverse Infected Variants: Face a wide range of zombie types, each with unique behaviors and combat patterns. From slow-moving hordes to specialized apex predators, you must adapt your tactics to survive each encounter.

  • Dynamic World Events: The world is alive and unpredictable. Encounter random map events such as supply plane crashes, high-value loot drops, or sudden horde migrations that force you to change your plans on the fly.

  • Tactical PvPvE Combat: Engage in high-stakes combat where you must balance the noise of fighting infected against the risk of attracting hostile players. Every sound could give away your position.

  • Realistic Gunplay & Customization: Master an extensive arsenal with realistic ballistics, recoil, and a deep attachment system.

  • Hardcore Survival & Extraction: Manage vitals, craft gear, and scavenge for supplies. Enter the zone, loot what you can, and reach extraction points. If you fall in battle, you lose everything.

The Objective

Loot. Survive. Extract. Your choices—and your ability to adapt to the changing world—will define your legacy.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Storage: 20 GB available space
